input.reply:
This warning is intentional, not a bug. In Vitest 4 the pool options were reworked: `test.poolOptions` was removed and its settings are now top-level options (for example `maxWorkers`, `isolate`, `execArgv`). Vitest prints the deprecation notice so a config that used to work doesn't silently ignore those settings.

To remove the warning, move your settings out of `poolOptions` to the top level. The migration guide has the full mapping: https://vitest.dev/guide/migration#pool-rework

I haven't searched the repo for the exact warning text, so the guide is the reference. If you follow it and the warning still appears, or a setting has no equivalent, open a new issue with your `vitest.config` and a minimal reproduction (a StackBlitz or a repo). Please also keep the tone constructive, as the Code of Conduct asks.
